title: probatio mutate.patch
description: Scores one change given as a unified diff, the way a mutant is scored: the usual use is to undo a fix and check that a named test fails. --package defaults to the git root of the working directory; outside a git checkout it must be passed. --patch is the diff text (pass it as --patch=<text>) or the path of a file that holds it; paths in it are from the top of the checkout or from the package. --reverse applies it in reverse (pass the fix's own diff to undo the fix). --tests names a test to run (repeat it); the names go at {tests} or {tests,} in the suite command, after -- for cargo test, or at the end for pytest; with no names the whole suite runs. The diff is applied with git apply in a mutant tree, never in your tree. The suite runs there once without it (it must pass) and once with it. outcome killed means a test failed with the diff applied; survived means nothing noticed it. unviable, timeout, and error are not scores (ok false). A kill is rerun twice unless --no-confirm. Every command prints one JSON object. schemaVersion changes when a field is renamed, removed, or changes meaning. A new field does not change it.

files.description: Files the diff changes, from the top of the checkout.
